# OpenGameArt — 2D Spell Effects

- Source: <https://opengameart.org/content/2d-spell-effects>
- Author: Martin Jelinek (Mikodrak)
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication)
- Downloaded: 2026-08-11

This directory preserves the original `FX.zip`, its supplied `YoudBetterReadMe.txt`,
the preview GIFs, and the individual transparent PNG animation frames.

The source page lists ten effects: blue overhead magic, sword fire, fireball, fire
rune, twin flames, eater fire, energy ball, lightning ball, rain-on-ground, and
black explosion. Attribution is not required by CC0, but this notice is retained
for provenance.
